word: It was beautiful, historical, artistically subtle, in a way that science can't capture.
meaning: 它美麗、有歷史感、藝術上細膩微妙，以一種科學無法捕捉的方式呈現。
example: The art of calligraphy had a beauty and depth that no scientific formula could explain.
hint:
中文解釋：Jobs 對書法的深度讚嘆，強調藝術與人文的獨特價值，是科學難以取代的。
1) artistically subtle (phr.): 藝術上細膩微妙的；syn: aesthetically refined; ant: crude
2) capture (v.): 捕捉、掌握；syn: grasp; ant: miss
pronunciation: Admiring: beau-ti-FUL | his-TOR-i-cal | ar-TIS-tic-ally SUB-tle | sci-ENCE can't CAP-ture.

example: He was completely captivated by what he was learning.
hint:
中文解釋：簡潔表達發自內心的熱情，呼應「找到自己所愛」的主題。
1) found (v.): 覺得、發現；syn: considered; ant: ignored
2) fascinating (adj.): 迷人的、令人著迷的；syn: captivating; ant: boring
pronunciation: Genuine: And I FOUND it fas-ci-NA-ting. (warm, unhurried)

word: None of this had even a hope of any practical application in my life.
meaning: 這一切看起來絲毫沒有任何實際應用到我人生中的希望。
example: At the time, he saw no way that calligraphy would ever be useful to him.
hint:
中文解釋：關鍵轉折前的鋪墊——當時看似毫無用處，才更能凸顯後來的驚喜。
1) practical application (n.): 實際應用；syn: real-world use; ant: theoretical
2) not even a hope (phr.): 連一點希望都沒有；syn: no chance at all; ant: great potential
pronunciation: Ironic: NONE of this | had EVEN a HOPE | of any PRAC-ti-cal ap-pli-CA-tion.

word: But ten years later, when we were designing the first Macintosh computer, it all came back to me.
meaning: 但十年後，當我們在設計第一台麥金塔電腦時，這一切都回到了我的腦海中。
example: A decade later, while working on the Macintosh, all those calligraphy lessons suddenly became relevant.
hint:
中文解釋：核心轉折——看似無用的知識，在十年後設計 Mac 時全部派上用場。
1) ten years later (phr.): 十年後；syn: a decade later; ant: immediately
2) came back to me (phr.): 回到腦海、想起來了；syn: resurfaced; ant: was forgotten
pronunciation: Revelation: TEN YEARS LA-ter | when we were de-SIGN-ing | the first MAC-in-TOSH | it ALL came BACK.

word: And we designed it all into the Mac.
meaning: 我們把這一切都設計進了麥金塔電腦裡。
example: All the calligraphy knowledge was built directly into the Mac's design.
hint:
中文解釋：點明書法知識的實際成果——Mac 的字體設計直接來自書法課的學習。
1) designed into (phr.): 設計進去、融入設計；syn: incorporated into; ant: excluded from
2) the Mac (n.): 麥金塔電腦（Mac）；syn: Macintosh; ant: (n/a)
pronunciation: Proud: And we de-SIGNED it ALL | in-to the MAC. (short, definitive)

word: It was the first computer with beautiful typography.
meaning: 它是第一台擁有美麗字體排版的電腦。
example: The Macintosh became the first personal computer to feature elegant, well-designed fonts.
hint:
中文解釋：強調 Mac 的歷史性突破——因為書法課，才有了美麗的電腦字體設計。
1) typography (n.): 字體排版；syn: font design; ant: plain text
2) beautiful (adj.): 美麗的；syn: elegant; ant: plain
pronunciation: Historic: It was the FIRST com-PU-ter | with beau-ti-FUL ty-POG-ra-phy.

word: If I had never dropped in on that single course in college, the Mac would have never had multiple typefaces or proportionally spaced fonts.
meaning: 如果我當時沒有旁聽那門大學裡的書法課，麥金塔電腦就永遠不會有多種字體或等比例間距的字型。
example: Without that one calligraphy class, the Mac would have lacked the font variety it became famous for.
hint:
中文解釋：用假設句強調那門書法課對科技史的深遠影響。
1) dropped in on (phr.): 旁聽、順道參加；syn: attended informally; ant: officially enrolled
2) proportionally spaced (adj.): 等比例間距的；syn: kerned; ant: monospaced
pronunciation: Conditional: If I had NEV-er | DROPPED IN on that COURSE | the MAC would NEV-er have had | MULT-iple TYPE-fac-es.

word: And since Windows just copied the Mac, it's likely that no personal computer would have them.
meaning: 而由於 Windows 只是複製了麥金塔的設計，很可能沒有任何個人電腦會有這些功能。
example: Because Windows followed the Mac's lead, all computers today have beautiful typography thanks to that class.
hint:
中文解釋：一個書法課的選擇，影響了整個個人電腦產業——極具震撼力的結論。
1) copied (v.): 複製、抄襲；syn: imitated; ant: innovated
2) personal computer (n.): 個人電腦；syn: PC; ant: mainframe
pronunciation: Bold claim: WIN-dows just COP-ied the MAC | it's LIKE-ly | NO per-son-al COM-pu-ter | would HAVE them.
